high_level_description: A wide cinematic shot of a camel caravan crossing tall orange sand dunes at golden hour, long shadows.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Endless rolling sand dunes under a clear pale sky, the low sun on the right raking across the ridges and casting long blue shadows.

elements.desc: Line of seven camels walking along a dune crest from left to right, silhouetted against the sky, each carrying patterned saddle bags.
Two travellers in indigo robes and head wraps leading the first camels on foot.
Wind blowing a fine plume of sand off the top of the nearest dune in the foreground.
